author: nickyeow

english.text: Have you got a lighter?
Do you have a lighter?

jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 daa2 fo2 gei1 aa3？
text: 你有冇打火機呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't worry too much, or you'll go bald.

jyutping: m4 hou2 gam3 daam1 sam1 laa1，jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 wui5 lat1 tau4 faat3 gaa3。
text: 唔好咁擔心啦，如果唔係會甩頭髮㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Apart from her, everybody answered the question.

jyutping: zing6 hai6 dak1 keoi5 mou4 daap3 dou3 tiu4 man6 tai4。
text: 淨係得佢無答到條問題。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tomorrow, I'm going to study at the library.

jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 tou4 syu1 gun2 wan1 syu1。
text: 我聽日去圖書館溫書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How much is the monthly fee of this swimming school?

jyutping: ne1 gaan1 jau4 seoi2 hok6 haau6 mui5 go3 jyut6 jiu3 bei2 gei2 do1 hok6 fai3 gaa3？
text: 呢間游水學校每個月要俾幾多學費㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He would be very glad to hear the news.

jyutping: keoi5 teng1 dou3 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1，sat6 wui5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 daan6 hei2。
text: 佢聽到呢個消息，實會開心到彈起。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He could not help jumping for joy at the good news.

jyutping: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go2 go3 hou2 siu1 sik1，hoi1 sam1 dou3 daan6 zo2 hei2 san1。
text: 佢聽到嗰個好消息，開心到彈咗起身。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I think I understand.

jyutping: ngo5 nam2 ngo5 ming4 gaa3 laa3。
text: 我諗我明㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Because of the bad weather, he couldn't come.

jyutping: jan1 wai6 tin1 hei3 hou2 caa1，so2 ji5 keoi5 lai4 m4 dou3。
text: 因為天氣好差，所以佢嚟唔到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't speak with your hands in your pockets.

jyutping: gong2 je5 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 caap3 zek3 sau2 lok6 go3 doi6 dou6。
text: 講嘢嗰陣唔好插隻手落個袋度。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Frankly speaking, I don't like your haircut.

jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 aa1，ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 nei5 go3 faat3 jing4。
text: 老實講吖，我真係唔係好鍾意你個髮型。

author: michu

english.text: It is impossible to do it.

jyutping: zyut6 deoi3 m4 ho2 nang4 gam1 zou6。
text: 絕對唔可能甘做。

author: tigro1973

english.text: Can you help me wash the dishes?

jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 sai2 wun2？
text: 可唔可以幫我洗碗？

author: tigro1973

english.text: I have no appetite.

jyutping: ngo5 mou5 wai6 hau2。
text: 我冇胃口。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you don't want to go, you don't have to.

jyutping: nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 m4 sai2 gaap3 ngaang6 heoi3 gaa3 wo3。
text: 你唔想去唔使夾硬去㗎喎。

author: fercheung

english.text: Are you excited?

jyutping: hing1 m4 hing3 fan5 aa3？
text: 興唔興奮呀？

author: kaenif

english.text: My cat barks.

jyutping: ngo5 zek3 maau1 fai6。
text: 我隻貓吠。

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom's great-grandfather was born blind.

jyutping: Tom ge3 taai3 gung1 tin1 saang1 hai6 maang4 ge3。
text: Tom嘅太公天生係盲嘅。

author: kaenif

english.text: The police will just take the money and probably won't even look for the owner.

jyutping: di1 ging2 caat3 zing6 hai6 wui5 tan1 zo2 di1 cin2，jing1 goi1 lin4 mat6 zyu2 dou1 m4 wui5 wan2。
text: 啲警察剩係會呑咗啲錢，應該連物主都唔會搵。

author: kaenif

english.text: How many human beings live on Earth?

jyutping: dei6 kau4 jau5 gei2 do1 jan4 zyu6 ne1？
text: 地球有幾多人住呢？

author: kaenif

english.text: I'm going to do that again.

jyutping: ngo5 wui5 zoi3 zou6 do1 ci3。
text: 我會再做多次。

author: nickyeow

english.text: No one is listening to her.
No one is listening to him.

jyutping: mou5 jan4 teng1 keoi5 gong2 je5。
text: 冇人聽佢講嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: A bird shat on my aunt's car.

jyutping: jau5 zek3 zoek3 zai2 o1 zo2 duk1 si2 lok6 ngo5 aa3 ji1 gaa3 ce1 dou3。
text: 有隻雀仔痾咗篤屎落我阿姨架車到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My mother takes a nap every afternoon.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 mui5 jat6 aan3 zau3 dou1 wui6 fan3 aan3 gaau3。
text: 我阿媽每日晏晝都會瞓晏覺。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Excuse me, may I have a spoon?

jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3，ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 go3 gang1 ngo5 aa3？
text: 唔好意思呀，可唔可以俾個羹我呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm incapable of concentrating.

jyutping: ngo5 zaap6 zung1 m4 dou3 zing1 san4 gaa3。
text: 我集中唔到精神㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I wish I were you.

jyutping: nei5 zau6 hou2 laa1。
text: 你就好啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla was coming back to Cairo.

jyutping: leoi5 laai1 faan2 gan2 heoi3 hoi1 lo4。
text: 蕾拉返緊去開羅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Shooting from a low angle makes your legs appear longer.

jyutping: dai1 caau2 wui6 jing2 dou3 deoi3 goek3 coeng4 di1。
text: 低炒會影到對腳長啲。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You can speak a foreign language more quickly if you're not afraid of making mistakes.

jyutping: m4 geng1 co3，hok6 ngoi6 jyu5 zau6 wui5 hok6 dak1 faai3 di1。
text: 唔驚錯，學外語就會學得快啲。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Once upon a time, there lived a stingy old man in the village.

jyutping: cung4 cin4，cyun1 leoi5 min6 zyu6 zo2 jat1 go3 gu1 hon4 ge3 aa3 baak3。
text: 從前，村裏面住咗一個孤寒嘅阿伯。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I purchased a telescope and a book on astronomy.

jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 mong6 jyun5 geng3 tung4 maai4 jat1 bun2 tin1 man4 hok6 ge3 syu1。
text: 我買咗個望遠鏡同埋一本天文學嘅書。

author: cheeseisdisgusting

english.text: Do you like tennis?

jyutping: nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 mong5 kau4 gaa3？
text: 你鐘唔鐘意網球㗎？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Werewolves appear on the full moon.

jyutping: mun5 jyut6 go2 zan6，zau6 jau5 long4 jan4 ceot1 mut6。
text: 滿月嗰陣，就有狼人出沒。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: To be honest, we came to capture you.

jyutping: kei4 sat6 ne1，ngo5 dang2 hai6 loi4 zuk1 nei5 gaa3！
text: 其實呢，我等係來捉你㗎！

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Singing is a lot of fun.
Singing is really exciting!

jyutping: coeng3 go1 hou2 hoi1 sam1 gaa3！
text: 唱歌好開心㗎！

author: thesilhouette

english.text: It was quite fantastic.

jyutping: （ni1 gin6 si6）dou1 gei2 zing3 gaa3。
text: （呢件事）都幾正㗎。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Randall Luthi is the director of the National Ocean Industries Association (NOIA) which represents more than 250 domestic offshore energy industries. During the Bush administration, he was director of the Minerals Management Service which oversees offshore drilling at the Interior Department.

jyutping: Randall Luthi hai6 doi6 biu2 ciu1 gwo3 250 go3 gwok3 noi6 hoi2 soeng6 nang4 jyun4 hong4 jip6 ge3 gwok3 gaa1 hoi2 joeng4 gung1 jip6 hip3 wui2（ NOIA ）ge3 zyu2 jam6。hai2 bou3 sap6 zing3 fu2 kei4 gaan1，keoi5 hai6 kwong3 mat6 gun2 lei5 fuk6 mou6 guk6 ge3 zyu2 jam6，fu6 zaak3 gaam1 duk1 gan2 noi6 zing3 bou6 hai2 hoi2 soeng6 ge3 zyun3 taam3。
text: Randall Luthi 係代表超過250個國內海上能源行業嘅國家海洋工業協會（ NOIA ）嘅主任。喺布什政府期間，佢係礦物管理服務局嘅主任，負責監督緊內政部喺海上嘅鑽探。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Nevertheless, while their doings were not recognized officially by the government, the perpetrators were neither punished nor reprimanded for their excursions against Spanish commerce at home or in the West Indies; rather were they commended, and it was considered not altogether a discreditable thing for men to get rich upon the spoils taken from Spanish galleons in times of nominal peace.

jyutping: bat1 gwo3，seoi1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 hang4 wai4 mou5 dak1 dou3 zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 sik1 sing4 jing6，daan6 hai6 faan6 jan4 hai2 gwok3 noi6 waak6 ze2 sai1 jan3 dou6 kwan4 dou2 faan2 deoi3 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 soeng1 jip6 ge3 jau4 laam5，gei3 mou5 sau6 dou3 cing4 fat6，jik6 mou5 sau6 dou3 hin2 zaak3；ji4 hai6 keoi5 dei6 sau6 dou3 zaan3 soeng2，ji4 hai2 ming4 ji6 soeng6 ge3 wo4 ping4 si4 kei4，di1 jan4 kaau3 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 daai6 faan4 syun4 lo2 lai4 ge3 zin3 lei6 ban2 ji4 zi3 fu3，jik6 dou1 bei6 si6 wai4 m4 hai6 jat1 gin6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 ho2 seon3 ge3 si6。
text: 不過，雖然佢哋嘅行為冇得到政府嘅正式承認，但係犯人喺國內或者西印度群島反對西班牙商業嘅遊覽，既冇受到懲罰，亦冇受到譴責；而係佢哋受到讚賞，而喺名義上嘅和平時期，啲人靠西班牙大帆船攞嚟嘅戰利品而致富，亦都被視為唔係一件完全唔可信嘅事。
